# flutter-focus-timer

> Local-first Pomodoro engine rebuilt from an append-only event log, with suspend-safe catch-up on an injected clock, streak statistics and a versioned JSON export Dart package `trysac_flutter_focus_timer`, MIT licensed, Dart >= 3.14, Dart SDK
> libraries only.

## Docs

- [README](README.md): problem, install, usage example
- [AGENTS](AGENTS.md): commands, folder map, conventions, limits
- [Architecture](docs/ARCHITECTURE.md): shape of the library and its public API
- [Testing](docs/TESTING.md): how to run and extend the tests
